properties.markdown:
# SpotQ Microservices & Application Operations
*Real-time performance monitoring for API Gateway, microservices, background message queues, and databases.*

properties.query:
SOURCE "${log_group_services_arn}" |
stats count(*) as requests by @logStream
| sort requests desc
properties.title: Traffic Share by Microservice

properties.query:
SOURCE "${log_group_services_arn}" |
filter ispresent(statusCode) or ispresent(method) or @message like /(GET|POST|PUT|DELETE|PATCH)/
| stats count(*) as requests_per_minute by bin(1m)
properties.title: SpotQ API Requests (per minute)

properties.query:
SOURCE "${log_group_services_arn}" |
filter statusCode >= 500 or level = "ERROR"
| stats count(*) as errors_per_minute by bin(1m)
properties.title: SpotQ Server Errors (5xx per minute)

properties.query:
SOURCE "${log_group_services_arn}" |
filter level = "ERROR" or statusCode >= 400 or @message like /(?i)error|exception/
| stats count(*) as error_count by bin(5m)
properties.title: Application Error Trend (5xx and 4xx Errors)

properties.query:
SOURCE "${log_group_services_arn}" |
filter ispresent(statusCode)
| fields case(
    statusCode >= 500, "5xx Server Error",
    statusCode >= 400, "4xx Client Error",
    statusCode >= 300, "3xx Redirection",
    statusCode >= 200, "2xx Success",
    "Other"
  ) as ResponseCategory
| stats count(*) as total by ResponseCategory
| sort total desc
properties.title: HTTP Response Status Category (2xx Success vs 4xx vs 5xx)

properties.markdown:
## Microservices Live Activity Logs
*Structured log events showing Timestamp, Log Level, Message, HTTP Method, Endpoint URL, and Status Code.*

properties.query:
SOURCE "${log_group_services_arn}" |
filter @logStream like /api-gateway/
| fields @timestamp,
       case(response_code >= 500, "ERROR", response_code >= 400, "WARN", "INFO") as level,
       concat(method, " ", path) as message,
       method,
       path as url,
       response_code as statusCode
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
properties.title: API Gateway Logs

properties.query:
SOURCE "${log_group_services_arn}" |
fields @timestamp, coalesce(level, "INFO") as level, coalesce(msg, @message) as message, method, url, statusCode
| filter @logStream like /user-service/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
properties.title: User Service Logs
